lines.text: Sagittarius, nobody is trying to cage you. They just asked what you're doing Friday.
lines.caption: it was just friday

lines.text: Sagittarius, the plane ticket will not fix what is waiting in the carry-on.
lines.caption: it's in the carry-on

lines.text: Sagittarius, the one-way ticket is not the only way to feel free.
lines.caption: you can stay and be free

lines.text: Sagittarius, starting over again is still starting. Finish one thing this time.
lines.caption: finish one thing

lines.text: Sagittarius, honesty lands softer when you stay in the room after saying it.
lines.caption: stay after the truth

lines.text: Sagittarius, the itch to leave is sometimes just the itch to feel something.
lines.caption: what are you feeling

lines.text: Sagittarius, a joke is not an answer to the question they asked.
lines.caption: answer the question

lines.text: Sagittarius, freedom grows faster with a little routine under it.
lines.caption: routine is a runway

lines.text: Sagittarius, freedom with no one to come home to starts to feel like weather.
lines.caption: free and a little cold

lines.text: Sagittarius, not every restless night is a sign. Some are just Tuesday.
lines.caption: it's just tuesday

lines.text: Sagittarius, they can love the traveler and still want to know the return date.
lines.caption: tell them when

lines.text: Sagittarius, the joke protects you. It also keeps everyone from seeing you.
lines.caption: drop the bit

lines.text: Sagittarius, leaving first does not mean it hurt less.
lines.caption: it still hurt

lines.text: Sagittarius, a dream with no deadline is just a nice place to visit.
lines.caption: give it a date

lines.text: Sagittarius, commitment is just choosing the same horizon twice.
lines.caption: same horizon twice

lines.text: Sagittarius, it's allowed to stay somewhere long enough to grow roots.
lines.caption: roots are allowed

lines.text: Sagittarius, honesty without warmth is just a weather report on their flaws.
lines.caption: say it kinder

lines.text: Sagittarius, the truth you tell everyone else works on you too. Try it.
lines.caption: same rules for you

lines.text: Sagittarius, laughing it off works until they stop laughing with you.
lines.caption: they stopped laughing

lines.text: Sagittarius, boredom is not danger. Sit with it and see what it wants.
lines.caption: sit with it

lines.text: Sagittarius, staying is also an adventure. It just has fewer airports.
lines.caption: the local adventure

lines.text: Sagittarius, the horizon moves when you move. That's how horizons work.
lines.caption: it will always move

lines.text: Sagittarius, they did not lose interest. They got tired of chasing a moving target.
lines.caption: stand still a second

lines.text: Sagittarius, ten half-read books are not the same as one finished one.
lines.caption: finish the book

lines.text: Sagittarius, ghosting is still a message. It just has no return address.
lines.caption: no return address

lines.text: Sagittarius, optimism is a gift. Planning is what makes it land.
lines.caption: plan the landing

lines.text: Sagittarius, the right person will not need you to stand still. Only to stand near.
lines.caption: just stand near

lines.text: Sagittarius, the next big thing might be finishing this small thing.
lines.caption: the small thing first

lines.text: Sagittarius, maybe the spark didn't fade. Maybe you just stopped looking at it.
lines.caption: look again

lines.text: Sagittarius, running looks like freedom from far away.
lines.caption: from far away

lines.text: Sagittarius, a heart that wanders still needs a local address.
lines.caption: where do you live

lines.text: Sagittarius, your savings account would like to be included in the adventure.
lines.caption: budget the trip

lines.text: Sagittarius, saying not ready yet for a whole year is a kind of answer.
lines.caption: that was the answer

lines.text: Sagittarius, laughing it off is still carrying it.
lines.caption: still carrying it

lines.text: Sagittarius, they texted back. You were the one already halfway out the door.
lines.caption: halfway out again

lines.text: Sagittarius, a quiet year can change you more than a loud one.
lines.caption: the quiet year

lines.text: Sagittarius, closeness is not a trap. It only feels like one when it's new.
lines.caption: not a trap

lines.text: Sagittarius, wisdom is not collected in passport stamps alone.
lines.caption: not just stamps

lines.text: Sagittarius, the brutal truth and the kind truth are usually the same sentence, slower.
lines.caption: say it slower

lines.text: Sagittarius, the version of you that stays put is not smaller. Just still.
lines.caption: still, not small

lines.text: Sagittarius, not every quiet night together is the start of a cage.
lines.caption: it's just a quiet night

lines.text: Sagittarius, what are you actually walking away from this time?
lines.caption: be honest with you

lines.text: Sagittarius, what if the person is the trip?
lines.caption: what if

lines.text: Sagittarius, discipline is just freedom with a calendar.
lines.caption: freedom with a calendar

lines.text: Sagittarius, keeping it casual forever is still a decision.
lines.caption: casual is a choice

lines.text: Sagittarius, the arrow only flies if someone holds the bow steady.
lines.caption: hold the bow

lines.text: Sagittarius, they asked for a little more of you, not a little less of your life.
lines.caption: more of you

lines.text: Sagittarius, it would be different somewhere else, you said. Is it?
lines.caption: is it though

lines.text: Sagittarius, the grass looks greener from every place you've ever left.
lines.caption: it's the distance

lines.text: Sagittarius, the cycle ends when you finally unpack the bag.
lines.caption: break the loop

lines.text: Sagittarius, run if you must, but tell them where you're going.
lines.caption: leave a note

lines.text: Sagittarius, some answers only arrive after you stop moving.
lines.caption: stop for a second

lines.text: Sagittarius, someone who lets you roam is rare. Notice when you find them.
lines.caption: notice them

lines.text: Sagittarius, being the fun one is not the same as being okay.
lines.caption: are you okay though

lines.text: Sagittarius, the ones who stayed weren't boring. They were brave in a different way.
lines.caption: staying is brave

lines.text: Sagittarius, home can be a place you build, not just a place you left.
lines.caption: build the home

lines.text: Sagittarius, you keep your bags packed by the door like love is a fire drill.
lines.caption: unpack one bag

lines.text: Sagittarius, rest is not a detour. It is part of the road.
lines.caption: rest is the road

lines.text: Sagittarius, fear of forever is usually just fear of being seen up close.
lines.caption: up close is okay

lines.text: Sagittarius, your restlessness is data, not destiny.
lines.caption: data not destiny
